trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap stages in order, and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: the only trophy that can be missed is a Chapter 1 meditation, and a chapter save is your safety net.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn every other trophy in this guide.
The Platinum pops automatically once the 54th is earned.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission, so this pops naturally as you play — no extra work needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1 and play the mission Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The pop comes a little late: it unlocks after you finish the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, rather than at the chapter credits.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through Chapter 1 to its end.
Start Chapter 2 and finish What's in the Bag? — the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 begins, right after the mission Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through Chapter 2 to its end.
Begin Chapter 3 with Welcome to Vice City — the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through Chapter 3 to its end.
In Chapter 4, finish Ocean Beach and Another Life — the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops after the chapter's last main mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through Chapter 4 to its end.
Finish the mission Starting From Zero — the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. No branching final choice locks this trophy — complete the story and it pops. Free-roam continues after the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the story to its final mission.
Finish the final mission — the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Chapter 2.
Play and finish the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach Chapter 3.
Play and finish the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. It pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Play and finish the mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. It pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Play and finish the mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Play and finish the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Chapter 5.
Play and finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion — check it in Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story. You do not need a literal 100% of everything: the checklist asks for all robberies (8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), all shooting-range gold medals, all drone races and 15 Target Deck cards for Bret, plus partial counts — 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Side progress made during the story counts, so play normally and clean up in free-roam. Nothing on the checklist is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see what is left.
Clear the full requirements first: all robberies, shooting-range golds, drone races, 15 Target Deck cards.
Top up the partial counts (missions, scans, studies, meditations, challenges, stunts, WAiNK) in free-roam.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: As Lucia, finish Andy's five missions in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass — the trophy pops on the last one. The questline starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts Lucia the address of his house in Belville; it is marked on the map. It stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, wait for Andy's call and text, then go to his house in Belville.
Work through the five missions in order, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure questline: dive 7 shipwrecks, follow the purple treasure-chest markers on the map, dig up each treasure with the metal detector on the sea floor, and return it to Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento). Track it in Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton disappears for a while after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3; the questline stays completable after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Start in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton); Kenton calls and is marked on the map.
Dive the 7 wrecks, dig up each treasure with the metal detector, and return them to Kenton.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes — the trophy pops on the last one. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 story mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 story mission Coffee Break.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and work through Billy's five jobs in order.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver 16 sports cars to Randy's garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). The first car, the Granforma Zorrusso, is delivered automatically during the Chapter 3 story mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also unlocks the Key Cloner. The other 15 are the Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee and Gallivanter Baller ST-D. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the wishlist; good hunting grounds are around the hotels on Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Better car condition pays more. Track it in Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 story mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock the Key Cloner and the wishlist.
Deliver the 15 remaining wishlist cars to Randy's garage in west Vice City.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: As Jason, destroy the Synthetic Labs (purple markers in Vice City) in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then finish Tyrone's final mission Spin On This / Shut Down the Labs — the trophy pops there. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 story mission Here, Kitty Kitty. It stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 story mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
As Jason, destroy the Synthetic Labs, then finish Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of 397 in total: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under-the-Bridge flights, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. Mix categories freely — the optional objectives inside each stunt are not required, just do the stunt once. The fastest route is Under-the-Bridge flights. Track it in Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the map can show every Stunt Spot (Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots). The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Turn on Stunt Spots on the map (Map > Exploration).
Complete any 250 stunts — Under-the-Bridge flights are the fastest.
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts for your count.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one ball), an arcade game, winning one race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and one stunt. Most are introduced by the story; the rest appear as you clear the map fog. Track it in Progress, then Activities — look for the blue dumbbell icons on the map. It usually pops on its own while you work on other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range and pool.
Sink a ball at basketball, finish an arcade game, win a race and do a stunt.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 2 ranges: Griffin Shooting Range in north-west Vice City (6 courses × 3 gold tiers = 18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch in north-east Port Gellhorn, Kelly County (6 courses × 4 gold tiers = 24 golds). Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk at each range first, or the challenges will not appear on the map; the $10 rental gun is good enough for gold. Track it in Progress, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus stat.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Buy the $5 waiver pass at Griffin Shooting Range and at Rodgers Ranch.
Earn gold in all 6 courses at each range, at every gold tier (42 golds total).

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total, 3 per location). One win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist needs all 42 races, so finish each location fully while you are there: beat par in the first two trials at a location to unlock the third trial, which only needs to be completed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun Drone Race location and win one race there.
Repeat at all 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race again does not count. The 100% checklist separately needs 30 of the 40 unique races plus 10 of the 13 Race Challenge gold medals — a different requirement, so do not confuse the two.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races — each new race you win counts once.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in his challenge. Your first time fishing is on Cal's boat in the Chapter 1 mission Recalibration. Cal stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Wait for his text, go to the marked spot and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game to the end — finish all of its levels once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. There are 4 games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all played on the TV at home (interact with the controller) from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck in arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the easiest one.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Play an arcade game at home on the TV, or at a cabinet.
Finish all of its levels once.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. Confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove strand), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count — they have their own trophies or are not strangers in the game's eyes. More qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. All strands stay available in free-roam after the story. As a precaution, do Yago's Race Against Yago promptly when it appears in Chapter 3 — it carries an hourglass icon.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish the Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete strands.
Complete 4 more qualifying stranger strands — check the trophy counter after each one.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida; meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts +2. Track it in Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The last spot, Ascent Meditation on the summit of Mount Kalaga, only appears once every other spot is done. THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation is on Jason's balcony in Chapter 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning until she says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. Gone permanently after Chapter 1; whether it counts is unconfirmed, so do it anyway and keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia is gone permanently after Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Whether it counts toward the trophy is not yet confirmed — do it anyway and keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia after Down to Earth — do not skip it.
Meditate at all 18 spots; bring both characters together where you can (counts double).
Finish at Ascent Meditation on Mount Kalaga, which appears last.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work Bret Vogel's hunting questline. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, playing as Jason (Lucia does not get the message), Bret texts you and marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. After that, Bret marks hunting spots (purple icons); hunt the animal he asks for and bring it to him as Jason. On the first quest Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (collect it from the weapon locker at Ammu-Nation). A clean single shot pays more but is not required. Which unique animal triggers the trophy is not yet confirmed — there are 15 Target Deck animals in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so expect it to pop naturally as you finish the Target Deck. Track it in Map, then Activities, then Target Deck.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), as Jason, answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals Bret marks and bring them to him; finish the Target Deck.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets — you do not need all of them. There are 18 sets and 480 cards in total (18–36 cards per set). Cards turn up in yellow phone boxes, tool boxes and on indoor surfaces. Track it in Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, which is far heavier. A complete card-location map does not exist yet — do not trust an unverified one.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards from phone boxes, tool boxes and indoor surfaces.
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up on the D-pad, then R1, while on foot (not in a vehicle); the game pops a notice when a scannable location is near. Any 100 locations count: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags. Track it in Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. The 100% checklist needs the same 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app on foot and scan locations (Up, then R1).
Scan 100 locations of any kind.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Track them in Progress, then Challenges (a check mark at the bottom right shows a completed one). Many complete naturally as you play; pick the easiest and fastest for the rest. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way to 100%.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress > Challenges and work through the easiest ones.
Complete 50 of the 80 challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — the point where Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad + Triangle), raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars (make trouble, or rob a bank vault, which always gives 4 stars), then escape until you are out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police and helicopters struggle to follow you there. It can also pop naturally while robbing a bank vault in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Escape until you leave the red heat zone entirely.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level in between — keep the flashing red and blue stars alive through all three. Bring body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs), close together. Rob a few items and crack the safe in each store. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop; if it does not pop, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: With your partner, rob a shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob two more shops back-to-back without losing the wanted level.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up, then R1) — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic going past. There are 557 vehicles at launch. Track progress in Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan passing traffic (Up, then R1).
Discover 100 different vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (slow-motion aim: L3+R3 while aiming). Fill your Focus bar first (eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home; Adrenaline extends the duration), then face a group of enemies — gang members at an Illegal Operation work best — with an assault rifle such as the Duke 556. Police, soldiers and civilians apparently do not count; only gang and criminal enemies. It gets easier as your Focus level rises (max level 4, raised through the shooting range, golf, pool, fishing and headshots).
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Fill your Focus bar, then activate Combat Focus (L3+R3) while aiming.
Take down 5 gang enemies in that one activation.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA (Vice City International Airport), steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a departure boarding bridge — planes parked out on the field do not count. Easiest at gates E3/E4: breach the airfield fence, climb the stairs beside the boarding bridge, enter, go up, get in the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport until the trophy pops (it is slightly delayed). Save first — the police arrive fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach a plane docked at a departure boarding bridge (gates E3/E4 are easiest).
Board it, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west corner of the map (Mariana County) — the tank is parked on the south side of the base. Get in through the gate or with a stunt jump near the south-east door, climb onto the tank, then shoot enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Steal the Rhino tank on the south side and shoot enemies from it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it gives you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry store robberies. Enter through the locked back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm). In the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave unseen. Both guides suggest Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. If you are spotted, reload your save — the store can be robbed again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun, crack the safe and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults (of 8 in total) and escape each time. First do the optional late Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — it introduces vault robberies (follow a security van to a bank and go in when the guard opens the vault). The loot is too heavy for one person, so bring a partner and hand one bag to them. After that mission, buy security van tips from Yasmani (the fence, $10,000 per tip, after you have robbed 2 Payday Loans for him) — vans are marked purple, follow one to a bank. A vault robbery gives 4 stars immediately; escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Each vault pays up to $205,000. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (late Chapter 4).
Buy van tips from Yasmani and rob 5 bank vaults, escaping each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The automatic way: robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck — the mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' gives you this trophy when you escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. The earlier way: ambush an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a sticky bomb on its rear door, blow it open, take the contents and escape the red heat zone. Sticky bombs are available behind Yasmani's shop after his mission.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Rob a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) — it counts automatically.
Or ambush an armored truck, blow its rear door with a sticky bomb and escape.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear all the fog from the map. The fastest way is to fly a plane over every dark patch of the map until the whole of Leonida is revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane and fly over every dark, fogged area of the map.
Keep going until no fog is left.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total; the 100% checklist needs all of them). Operations are marked with a yellow icon on the map as you approach them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track the count per gang in Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find Illegal Operations (yellow icons) and rob one for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method exists yet. All that is known is the official description: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City — but the exact place and steps are not confirmed by any source yet. Check back once a guide confirms it; do not trust a guessed location.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the method is still unknown.
The best lead: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, Vice City.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: According to PowerPyx (with screenshots): steal the specific blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City, then drive it straight through the showroom window — only that blue Banshee counts, not any other car. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs': hack that car, drive straight through the window, and the trophy pops after you pull away down the street (slightly delayed). Other sources still say the exact steps are not confirmed, so treat this as the best current lead rather than settled fact. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Get the Key Cloner from 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs' (Chapter 3).
Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — an Illegal Operation), steal all three key valuables: (1) the luxury watch in the south-east office, (2) the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the north-east corner table, (3) the safe contents in the north-east office hallway — blow the safe with a Sticky Bomb (buy one at Ammu-Nation first). The location is first marked by the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you take the third item. It is not missable: if you do not take everything in one visit, the operation respawns after a while and the rest can be collected on a later visit. You do not need to kill anyone.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Do the optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2) to mark the location.
Steal the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength for Jason AND Lucia at the same time. Train at a fitness club (buy a membership; filter Map, then Activities, dumbbell icon) — always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them): when one character trains, the partner trains automatically, so progress is doubled. Check the level in Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then pick a character, then Strength (heart icon). After the story you can also train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Buy a gym membership and call your partner to train with you.
Train until both Jason and Lucia reach maximum Strength.

trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — robberies, fights and almost any crime count, so this usually pops passively while you work on other trophies and 100%. To watch it: turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On) — each counted action shows a small devil-face icon on the right of the screen, and you can see the 500 progress by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. If it has not popped after everything else, the fastest farm is running over pedestrians and police with a car. Warning: do not push your profile to 'Irredeemable' — that status is permanent and the police get more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications to watch the count.
Do 500 profile-changing actions — it pops naturally during normal play.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method exists yet. The official description only says: Second time's the charm. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is not confirmed. Do not follow a guessed method — check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the method is still unknown.
Best unconfirmed lead (PowerPyx): the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method exists yet. The official description only says: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx believes it is from a UFO questline, but that is not confirmed. Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida — do not follow a guessed method until a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the method is still unknown.
Best unconfirmed lead (PowerPyx): a UFO questline.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method exists yet. The official description says: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The leading guess is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is not confirmed — do not treat it as fact. Wait for a confirmed guide before chasing it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the method is still unknown.
Best unconfirmed lead (PowerPyx): kicking enemies from a motorcycle.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts — cumulative, not all at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer that makes laundering marked bills possible. Then rob banks and Payday Loans (the proceeds come as marked bills) and sell them to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is reached naturally while robbing all the bank vaults (one vault pays up to $205,000).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to Yasmani until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops — anything counts: guns, car mods, tattoos, clothes and more. The fastest way is the most expensive items: guns at Ammu-Nation (24 stores), car mods and tattoos. Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Spray, 24 Ammu-Nation, 67 clothing stores, 17 shoe stores, 18 salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are fastest.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages you can purchase through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (about $160,000 in total). There are 12 garages in all: 8 you buy plus 4 from the story, which do not count. The app opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal a Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that a new app is installed.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages (about $160,000).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Bring a stolen vehicle to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, choose 'Respray', then 'Register'. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, vehicles with a Standard Tracker can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each registration needs an empty garage slot (see Little Boxes — buy garages first) and a fee, so use cheap cars and bikes. Registered vehicles can then be called and delivered to your location.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to install the Scooter Bros app.
Bring 10 vehicles to Moses' garage (or a Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3) and register each one.
